name: DCA Aunt Cass Café / Boudin Bakery Warm San Francisco Sourdough Loaf or Bread Bowl Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café & Boudin Bread Cart (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Baked fresh on-site inside DCA using Boudin's 1849 wild-yeast mother dough: strictly unbleached flour, water, salt, and long fermentation that pre-digests gluten and fructans (100% dairy-free, egg-free, nut-free, and oil-free!).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy a warm Baymax/Mickey Boudin Sourdough Loaf from the cart for flare-safe tearing all day, or order a Sourdough Bread Bowl at Aunt Cass Café with soup on the side (take lactase if choosing Clam Chowder or Mac & Cheese).
watchOuts: The sourdough bread itself is 9.5/10 flare-safe and dairy-free; Clam Chowder and Mac & Cheese fillings contain dairy and require lactase
